description: This file defines the ChatController class, which manages chat sessions, message flow, event handling, and state management for an Android chat application utilizing a gateway connection. It handles sending messages, receiving events, maintaining session states, and interacting with a backend via JSON-based protocols.

classes.name: ChatController
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing chat sessions, messaging, event handling, and state updates within the Android chat application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a session with the specified session key and initiates bootstrap process.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key for the chat and updates session state accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a full bootstrap to refresh session data and health status.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of available chat sessions, limited by optional parameter.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the level of 'thinking' (e.g., low, medium, high, off) for the chat.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches the active chat session to another specified by session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message and attachments, updates local message state.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for acceptance, returning success status.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming real-time events/messages from the gateway connection.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses chat history JSON into message objects and restores session state.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Parses session list JSON into a list of session entries.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes raw input into predefined thinking levels.
